title: A journalist's family: the oldest son

exchanges.q: Who did you live with in {COUNTRY}?
exchanges.a: With my parents and my two younger brothers. I am the oldest.

exchanges.q: How old were your brothers when you left?

a: My father was a journalist. In 2018 he wrote articles about the mayor.
In January 2019 men came to our house and took him. We have not heard from him since then.

exchanges.q: Who was at home when they took him?
exchanges.a: My mother, my brothers, and I. They told us not to say anything.

exchanges.q: What did your family do after that?
exchanges.a: We went to the police together, my mother and I. The police told us to stop looking.
Yes. In March 2019 a man stopped me on the street and said that I would end up like my father.
No, I did not report it. After what the police told us, I did not trust them.
She is still in {CITY} with my brothers. They moved to my aunt's house.

a: We did not have money for everyone to travel.
My mother decided that I should go first, because I am the oldest son.
